press_references.value: Madinet Masr welcomes Carrefour Store at its landmark project “Tajed” in Taj City, New Cairo

partnership_announcements.description: Madinet Masr and Majid Al Futtaim, operator of Carrefour in Egypt, commenced a commercial partnership with Carrefour becoming a key anchor tenant at the Tajed mixed-use project in Taj City, New Cairo.

press_references.value: Madinet Masr signs EGP 1.45bn MoU with Forward Contractors for Sarai construction works

partnership_announcements.description: Madinet Masr signed a memorandum of understanding with Forward Contractors for EGP 1.45 billion in construction works to build 95 residential villas in the Rai project within the Sarai development in East Cairo, supporting Madinet Masr’s expansion and project delivery strategy.

press_references.value: Partnership Between Madinet Masr and Waheej Real Estate Launches “Citydom” and Explores Land Acquisition in Al-Janadriyah

partnership_announcements.description: Madinet Masr and Waheej Real Estate formed a 50/50 joint venture called Citydom to develop sustainable, culturally aligned urban communities in Saudi Arabia, starting with potential land acquisition in Riyadh’s Al‑Janadriyah area.

press_references.value: Madinet Masr partners with Qubix, LA7 to launch commercial, wellness hubs in Tajed

partnership_announcements.description: Madinet Masr signed two strategic partnerships with Qubix Co. and LA7 to expand the Tajed district in New Cairo, including The Prism commercial and entertainment hub (over 7,000 sqm) and LA7’s largest 5,400 sqm wellness branch, slated for 2026–2027 openings.

press_references.value: Madinet Masr in talks for three land plots in Riyadh as part of Saudi expansion

partnership_announcements.description: Madinet Masr is partnering with Wahij Real Estate as its local partner in Saudi Arabia for its regional expansion.

press_references.value: Madinet Masr, Waheej sign MoU to drive strategic expansion in Saudi Arabia

partnership_announcements.description: Madinet Masr and Waheej for Real Estate signed a Memorandum of Understanding to explore joint development of residential, commercial, and administrative projects in Saudi Arabia, marking a strategic partnership for regional expansion.

press_references.value: Madinet Masr signs strategic partnership with GTCI Constructors

partnership_announcements.description: GTCI will expand water and irrigation tanks in Taj City, with constructions expected to be completed in 2025.

press_references.value: Egypt: Madinet Masr details portfolio expansion, launch of new subsidiaries

partnership_announcements.description: Madinet Masr and Saudi Arabia-based Waheej Real Estate launched Citydom as a joint regional real estate venture to support Madinet Masr's expansion outside Egypt.

press_references.value: Madinet Masr announces Elm Tree Park in Sarai

product_launches.description: Madinet Masr launched Elm Tree Park within its Sarai development near Egypt's New Administrative Capital, a 476,262 sqm project with 2,150 residential units and total investment of EGP 11 billion, featuring flexible payment plans.

press_references.value: Madinet Masr launches Shark Tank Business Park in Egypt's Taj City

product_launches.description: Madinet Masr has launched the Shark Tank Business Park in Egypt's Taj City, in collaboration with Innovative Media Production and Sony Pictures Entertainment. The business park is inspired by the international TV show Shark Tank and aims to serve as a hub for entrepreneurs, combining business, lifestyle, and entertainment across 16 buildings. The first phase is expected to be delivered by 2029, with over $1 billion in investments.

product.name: Taj City
product.description: An integrated mixed-use development on Cairo’s Suez Road near Heliopolis, Nasr City, and Cairo International Airport, offering residential communities and commercial destinations.

product.name: Sarai
product.description: An integrated residential community on Cairo-Suez Road spanning approximately 5.5 million square meters, with housing, commercial areas, landscaping, and community amenities.

product.name: Residential property development
product.description: Development and sale of apartments, villas, townhouses, and other residential units within planned communities across Egypt.

product.name: The Butterfly
product.description: A residential development in Mostakbal City, New Cairo, offering private housing with energy-efficient building and water-system features.

product.name: Zahw
product.description: A mixed-use development in West Assiut featuring residential properties, a commercial area, and a 20,000-square-meter sports club.

product.name: Commercial real estate developments
product.description: Development of commercial districts and business properties, including retail, dining, office, and service destinations within Madinet Masr communities.
